headline: Verstappen inherits Vegas pole after Antonelli's penalty, GTA 6 hits a record-equalling 99 on Metacritic, and Polaris 40 plus UFC Qatar fill tonight's fight card.

upcoming.what: UFC Qatar prelims, main card 18:00 (Irish time): Prochazka vs Stirling
Polaris 40 main card, Southampton: Irishman Sam McNally vs Garry Tonon for the lightweight title (prelims 14:30)
F1 Las Vegas GP race (Irish time), Verstappen on pole
F1 Qatar GP, the penultimate round (time TBC)
Cygnus CRS-25 cargo launch to the ISS

items.headline: Antonelli fastest in Vegas, but Verstappen starts on pole
items.summary: Kimi Antonelli topped qualifying by a quarter of a second, but a five-place penalty for power unit changes hands pole to Max Verstappen, with Russell and Norris alongside and behind.

items.headline: Penalties scramble the grid; Ferrari out in Q2
items.summary: Piastri and Sainz both take 10-place engine penalties, while Leclerc and Hamilton failed to reach Q3, leaving Racing Bulls rookie Lindblad and Hadjar near the front. Race is at 04:00 Sunday Irish time.

items.headline: Gemini can now drive your Mac
items.summary: Google launched a Gemini agent that operates Mac apps, sorts local files and fills in forms, initially for US paying subscribers in English.

items.headline: Apple reportedly building its own computer-use agent
items.summary: Bloomberg says Apple is working on an early-stage agent that can control apps, browse the web and write code.

items.headline: AI-assisted cyberattack hits the European Commission
items.summary: The attack temporarily disrupted payroll and medical reimbursement systems, and officials are checking whether staff data was taken.

items.headline: Microsoft unveils seven new in-house MAI models at Ignite
items.summary: The lineup spans coding, security, image generation and real-time speech, pitched as near-frontier performance at much lower cost.

items.headline: Hayabusa2 abandons its asteroid landing
items.summary: With its last working ion thruster failed, JAXA has dropped the planned touchdown on 1998 KY26 and will settle for a high-speed flyby of another near-Earth asteroid in 2028.

items.headline: Perseverance pauses science; Mars Odyssey offline
items.summary: Perseverance went into safe mode over a UHF radio issue and hopes to resume by month's end, while Odyssey is down after losing a reaction wheel.

items.headline: Google books New Glenn for orbital AI data centres
items.summary: Blue Origin will launch Google's Project Suncatcher satellites, solar-powered orbiters carrying TPU chips, with the first flight targeted for early 2029.

items.headline: Tonight in Cavan: mixed, Moon-dominated
items.summary: This run couldn't load a fresh Met Éireann forecast, so check before heading out. A bright waxing gibbous Moon (full on the 24th) rules the evening and sets in the small hours; darkness from about 18:15. Verdict: mixed, good for the Moon and bright planets in any clear breaks, deep-sky only after Moonset.

items.headline: GTA 6 scores 99 on Metacritic, tying Ocarina of Time
items.summary: Rockstar's launch now shares the highest critic average ever, with user scores opening on day two.

items.headline: Day-one revenue estimate climbs to $3.79bn
items.summary: A new estimate puts GTA 6's first-day takings well above yesterday's $2bn figure, cementing it as the biggest entertainment launch on record.

items.headline: Silent patches and a PSN wobble at launch
items.summary: Rockstar pushed two updates without patch notes, and a PSN outage hit players hours before unlock, though Rockstar's own servers held. Nothing new on the Witcher, Cyberpunk 2 or Borderlands watchlist.

items.headline: Polaris 40 tonight: McNally vs Tonon II
items.summary: Irish grappler Sam McNally defends the Polaris lightweight title against Garry Tonon in Southampton, a rematch of McNally's ADCC 2022 upset; main card from 19:00. Otherwise a quiet news day.

items.headline: UFC Qatar tonight: Prochazka vs unbeaten Stirling
items.summary: Former champion Jiri Prochazka can climb back into title contention against 11-0 Navajo Stirling in Doha, with Sterling vs Vallejos and Hooker vs Ortega on the main card (18:00 Irish).
